lede: Elevated Faith sells Christian jewelry and apparel: WWJD bracelets, faith rings, hoodies and tees with Bible verses. Here's what buyers say about it, and the complaints worth knowing before you order.

parts: Yes, Elevated Faith is legit. It's a US brand based in Oshkosh, Wisconsin, founded in 2015 by Josh Gander, and its best sellers average 4.8 to 4.9 stars from hundreds of reviews each. Trustpilot gives it 4.6 from 408 reviews. The main complaints are slow or missing deliveries and slow replies from customer service.

Faith-themed jewelry and clothing: WWJD and verse bracelets, rings, necklaces, hoodies, tees, crewnecks, phone cases, stickers and kids' clothes. Elevated Faith says it gives a portion of every sale to faith-based organizations.
Best sellers include the WWJD Bracelet at $4.99, the Highs and Lows Ring at $9.99, the Promise Ring at $19.99 and the Child of God Unisex Hoodie at $69.99.

parts: Nine in ten reviews of the best sellers are 5 stars: 1,382 of 1,536 for the Highs and Lows Ring and 1,121 of 1,248 for the WWJD Bracelet. On the Child of God Hoodie, reviewers rate the fit true to size and the quality near the top of the scale.

The low reviews on Trustpilot are mostly about orders that arrived late or not at all, slow replies from customer service, and prices that some find high. One reviewer said shirts labeled as made in the USA were made in China, and a few complaints come from its affiliate program rather than from shoppers.

Yes. It's a real business with a public founder, a Wisconsin address in its store details, a help center, and thousands of product reviews. The complaints we found are about delivery and support. Buy only on elevatedfaith.com, keep your tracking email, and contact orders@elevatedfaith.com if a package stalls.

Bracelets and rings are cheap enough for a gift at $4.99 to $19.99, while hoodies at $64.99 to $69.99 cost more than plain blanks; you're paying for the design and the message. Free shipping starts at $100, and the Sale section often has mystery items at half price.
